back: Male donkey, female donkey, young donkey.
Mule = jack × mare; hinny = stallion × jenny; both usually sterile.
About 12 months (often a little more); usually one foal.
Donkeys: cheaper, less feed and water, drought hardy, easy to handle. But weaker and slower; a span is needed.
Their coats are not very waterproof; they need protection from rain and cold as well as shade.
Broad, padded, well-fitting, clean harness; check skin after work; rest until healed; avoid overloading.
Pick out hooves; trim about every 2-3 months or when overgrown; keep standing areas dry.
Handle foals early; wean about 6 months; light work about 2-3 years; full work about 4 years.
